name: rust-1
prompt:
Implement the search engine described in SPEC.md (in this directory) in Rust.

- Write all code in this directory; do not read or write anything outside it
  (except the toolchain, package registries and caches).
- Toolchain: Rust 1.98.1 (cargo). Network access for dependencies is available.
- Build in release mode: `cargo build --release`. The binary must be `./target/release/search`.
- Done means: `python3 run_tests.py ./target/release/search` reports 0 failed.
- It will be benchmarked as described in the Performance section of SPEC.md.
- When done, reply with a short summary of the design.
